### EQ001 — Squeezing-dependent nonreciprocal coupling

*Defines Figure 1(c) and the symmetry-breaking design rule.*

$$
G=\left|\cosh r_a\cosh r_b-e^{i\Delta\theta}\sinh r_a\sinh r_b\right|
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/Manuscript.tex:95-123; main-text Eqs. (3)-(4)

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate the complex amplitude on Delta theta and Delta r grids with r_a=r+Delta r/2 and r_b=r-Delta r/2.
```

### EQ002 — Steady-state battery energies

*Generates Figure 2(c), Figure 3, and Figure S3.*

$$
E_a^{ss}=E^{ss}+\frac{8J^2\kappa\sinh^2r}{(2J+\kappa)^3},\quad E_b^{ss}=E^{ss}+\frac{2J(4J^2+\kappa^2)\sinh^2r}{(2J+\kappa)^3},\quad E_c^{ss}=E^{ss}+\frac{2J\sinh^2r}{2J+\kappa}
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/Manuscript.tex:137-149; main-text Eq. (5)

Numerical form:

```
Vectorize the three rational functions over J and r; retain E^ss as a separate baseline and derive E_i^ss/E^ss without using source pixels as numerical inputs.
```

### EQ003 — Coupling derivatives of the steady-state energies

*Locates the optimal-coupling branches and threshold squeezing in Figures 3 and S2.*

$$

$$

### EQ004 — Normal-plus-anomalous forward transmission

*Defines both panels of Figure 4 and separates normal from counter-rotating transmission.*

$$
T_{ba}=\frac{64J^2\kappa_a\kappa_b}{\Lambda_b^2+(2\omega+\omega_s)^2}\left[\frac{|g_N|^2}{\Lambda_a^2+(2\omega+\omega_s)^2}+\frac{|g_A|^2}{\Lambda_a^2+(-2\omega+\omega_s)^2}\right]
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_tex: paper-source/Manuscript.tex:515-601; supplemental scattering matrix

Numerical form:

```
Evaluate the two rational channels on normalized omega/Gamma and omega_s/Gamma grids; cross-check the omega_s=0 closed form.
```
